changes_from_parent: Replace ambiguous raw matter-power coordinate by explicitly comoving total-matter spectrum P_Delta.
Require same-solver reference quotients for model/reference perturbation responses whenever possible.
Require source/provenance audit showing how each solver constructs Delta_m and the matter component set.
Species-level gauge-specific delta/theta transfer columns are diagnostic only unless separately validated.
Raw mPk may be used only when source audit establishes that it is constructed from the same comoving Delta_m definition and a high-precision gauge audit passes.

reference_conventions.primordial_rule: Hold A_s, n_s and other primordial parameters fixed for raw theory-response comparisons unless an explicitly documented nuisance projection is applied.
reference_conventions.growth_normalization_rule: Never independently impose D(a=1)=1 when amplitude information is being compared.
reference_conventions.reference_solver_rule: For a model generated by solver S, compute its reference cosmology with the same solver S and matched numerical settings before taking a log response. Cross-solver absolute spectra are not treated as one coordinate without a separate bridge validation.
reference_conventions.matter_component_rule: The matter component set entering rho_m, p_m, delta_m and theta_m must be explicit and matched between model and reference.

core_channels.name: comoving_matter_power_fixed_primordial
core_channels.definition: P_Delta is the power spectrum of Delta_m = delta_m + 3(1+w_m) a H theta_m/k^2, with w_m=p_m/rho_m for the documented total matter component set.

derived_or_optional_channels.name: ap_response
derived_or_optional_channels.rule: Derived geometric response. Do not count it as independent if parent geometry coordinates are already present.

derived_or_optional_channels.name: growth_rate
derived_or_optional_channels.rule: Optional discriminant channel after gauge/observable definition is documented.

derived_or_optional_channels.name: power_shape_quotient
derived_or_optional_channels.formula: r_Delta with a constant log-amplitude mode projected out using the same covariance/precision metric as the analysis
derived_or_optional_channels.rule: Derived quotient. Never concatenate raw r_Delta and its amplitude-quotiented copy in one rank calculation.

derived_or_optional_channels.name: weyl_metric_response
derived_or_optional_channels.rule: Optional until a common extractor is validated across all solver families.

solver_audit_rules: Record exact solver commit, gauge, component definition, numerical precision and reference configuration.
Demonstrate that the solver matter source is comoving/gauge invariant or reconstruct it explicitly before using P_Delta.
If a fork has output-title/index defects, exclude affected species-level transfer columns from common coordinates.
A solver zero-limit PASS does not by itself prove cross-solver comparability; response-quotient bridge tests are separate gates.
rank_rules: Whiten with observational/noise covariance before any rank claim.
Project exact definitions, Bianchi/conservation identities, calibration modes and measurement-induced nuisance directions before law discovery.
Do not count a derived channel and its parent coordinates simultaneously as independent dimensions.
Use only complete/common channel blocks when comparing model families unless a missing-data method has been separately validated.
Propagate theory-family weights into the null calibration used for R_model(pi).

scale_policy.linear_core: 0.001 <= k <= 0.1 h/Mpc on the frozen nodes is the first common linear response block.
scale_policy.extension: 0.2-1.0 h/Mpc is diagnostic/extension space and is not mixed into the core without nonlinear/model-validity gates.
scale_policy.ultra_large_scale: k < 0.001 h/Mpc remains a separate diagnostic sector for the pinned GDM implementation because of finite-start IC sensitivity.
